text: 床前明月光，疑是地上霜
pinyin: chuáng qián míng yuè guāng, yí shì dì shàng shuāng
literal: bed · front · bright · moon · light, suspect · be · ground · on · frost
natural: moonlight before my bed, I take it for frost on the ground

meaning.en: Opening of the best-known poem of homesickness: moonlight on the floor looks like frost.
meaning.zh: 《静夜思》开头，月光洒在床前，恍若地上的白霜，引出思乡之情。

equivalents: moonlight like frost on the floor
a night of homesick quiet

examples.zh: 每个中国孩子都会背“床前明月光，疑是地上霜”。
examples.en: Every Chinese child can recite '§'.

examples.zh: 床前明月光，疑是地上霜，这首诗写尽了游子的夜晚。
examples.en: §: this poem captures the wanderer's night.

story.en: Li Bai's 'Quiet Night Thought', written while he was far from home; the moonlight on the floor sets the mood for homesickness.
story.zh: 李白《静夜思》：游子夜深难眠，见月光洒地如霜，思乡之情油然而生。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 举头望明月，低头思故乡
pinyin: jǔ tóu wàng míng yuè, dī tóu sī gù xiāng
literal: raise · head · gaze at · bright · moon, lower · head · think of · old · home
natural: I look up at the bright moon, then bow my head and think of home

meaning.en: Looking at the moon makes a traveller long for home; quoted for homesickness, especially at Mid-Autumn.
meaning.zh: 望月思乡，常在中秋或游子思家时引用。

equivalents: homesick under the moon
a longing for home

examples.zh: 中秋夜，他在异国望着月亮，想起了“举头望明月，低头思故乡”。
examples.en: On Mid-Autumn night abroad, he looked at the moon and thought of '§'.

examples.zh: 留学生的朋友圈里满是“举头望明月，低头思故乡”。
examples.en: Students abroad filled their feeds with '§'.

story.en: The closing couplet of 'Quiet Night Thought': the poet lifts his eyes to the moon, then lowers them in homesickness.
story.zh: 李白《静夜思》末联：抬头望月，低头思乡。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟
pinyin: chūn mián bù jué xiǎo, chù chù wén tí niǎo
literal: spring · sleep · not · notice · dawn, everywhere · hear · crying · birds
natural: In spring I sleep past dawn and hear birdsong everywhere

meaning.en: Spring sleep is so sound that dawn goes unnoticed, and birdsong fills the air; a picture of easy spring mornings.
meaning.zh: 春天睡得香甜，不知天已亮，到处是鸟鸣，形容春日的惬意。

equivalents: sleeping in on a spring morning
spring birdsong

examples.zh: 春天的早晨总让人想起“春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟”。
examples.en: A spring morning always brings to mind '§'.

examples.zh: 周末睡到自然醒，真是“春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟”。
examples.en: Waking naturally at the weekend, it's truly '§'.

story.en: The opening of Meng Haoran's 'Spring Morning', often the first Tang poem a child learns.
story.zh: 孟浩然《春晓》开头，是许多孩子最早背诵的唐诗之一。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 白日依山尽，黄河入海流

literal: white · sun · lean on · mountains · vanish, Yellow · River · enter · sea · flow
natural: The sun sets behind the hills; the Yellow River flows into the sea

meaning.en: A grand view of the setting sun and the river running to the sea; quoted for sweeping scenery.
meaning.zh: 夕阳落山，黄河奔流入海，形容壮阔的景象。

equivalents: sunset over the hills, river to the sea
a sweeping landscape

examples.zh: 站在鹳雀楼上，才懂什么是“白日依山尽，黄河入海流”。
examples.en: Standing on Stork Tower, I finally understood '§'.

examples.zh: 摄影作品配上“白日依山尽，黄河入海流”，气势十足。
examples.en: The photograph, captioned '§', was full of grandeur.

story.en: The first couplet of Wang Zhihuan's 'Climbing Stork Tower'; the next couplet urges climbing one more storey to see farther.
story.zh: 王之涣《登鹳雀楼》前两句，后两句“欲穷千里目，更上一层楼”。

date.en: Tang dynasty, first half of 8th c.

text: 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟
pinyin: dàn yuàn rén cháng jiǔ, qiān lǐ gòng chán juān
literal: only · wish · people · long · lasting, thousand · li · share · beautiful moon
natural: May we live long, and share the lovely moon though a thousand miles apart

meaning.en: A wish that separated loved ones stay well and share the same moon; a Mid-Autumn blessing.
meaning.zh: 愿亲人平安长久，虽相隔千里仍共赏明月，是中秋常用的祝福。

equivalents: may we share the same moon
a Mid-Autumn wish for distant loved ones

examples.zh: 中秋节我给远方的父母发了短信：“但愿人长久，千里共婵娟”。
examples.en: At Mid-Autumn I texted my distant parents: '§'.

examples.zh: 月饼盒上印着“但愿人长久，千里共婵娟”。
examples.en: The mooncake box was printed with '§'.

origin.source: 苏轼《水调歌头·明月几时有》

story.en: Su Shi wrote the lyric on Mid-Autumn night in 1076, thinking of his brother Su Zhe from whom he had long been parted.
story.zh: 苏轼丙辰中秋所作，怀念久别的弟弟苏辙。

usage.en: Used as a blessing, especially at Mid-Autumn.
usage.zh: 常作祝福语，尤其用于中秋。

text: 路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索
pinyin: lù màn màn qí xiū yuǎn xī, wú jiāng shàng xià ér qiú suǒ
literal: road · long long · its · lengthy · far · [particle], I · will · up · down · and · seek
natural: The road is long and far; I will search high and low

meaning.en: The path is long, but I will keep seeking the truth; quoted to express perseverance in a lofty pursuit.
meaning.zh: 前路漫长遥远，我仍要上下探索，表达不懈追求真理的决心。

equivalents: a long road, but I will keep seeking
search high and low

examples.zh: 科研之路漫长，他常以“路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索”自勉。
examples.en: The road of research is long, and he often encourages himself with '§'.

examples.zh: 毕业典礼上，校长引用了“路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索”。
examples.en: At graduation the principal quoted '§'.

story.en: Qu Yuan, banished and misunderstood, resolves in the Lisao to keep seeking his ideal however long the road.
story.zh: 屈原《离骚》：诗人遭放逐仍矢志追求理想。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 温故而知新，可以为师矣
pinyin: wēn gù ér zhī xīn, kě yǐ wéi shī yǐ
literal: review · old · and · know · new, can · take · as · teacher · [particle]
natural: One who reviews the old and grasps the new is fit to be a teacher

meaning.en: Reviewing what you have learned and finding new insight qualifies you to teach others.
meaning.zh: 复习旧知并从中领悟新知，就有资格做老师。

equivalents: review the old to learn the new
one who revisits the old can teach

examples.zh: 老师说，“温故而知新，可以为师矣”，复习很重要。
examples.en: The teacher said, '§': revision matters.

examples.zh: 读经典要“温故而知新，可以为师矣”，常读常新。
examples.en: When reading classics, '§': they stay fresh with every reading.

story.en: Confucius on what makes a good teacher: someone who keeps reviewing old learning and draws new understanding from it.
story.zh: 孔子：“温故而知新，可以为师矣。”

usage.en: A quotation from the Analects; formal, used to make an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 《论语》引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆
pinyin: xué ér bù sī zé wǎng, sī ér bù xué zé dài
literal: learn · but · not · think · then · confused, think · but · not · learn · then · in peril
natural: Learning without thought is wasted; thought without learning is dangerous

meaning.en: Study without reflection leaves you confused, while reflection without study leaves you on shaky ground.
meaning.zh: 只读书不思考会迷惑，只思考不读书会疑惑不安，学习与思考须结合。

equivalents: learning and thinking go hand in hand
study without thought is blind

examples.zh: “学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆”，光背书不理解是没用的。
examples.en: '§': memorising without understanding is useless.

examples.zh: 老师用“学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆”提醒我们要边学边想。
examples.en: The teacher used '§' to remind us to think as we learn.

story.en: Confucius stresses that learning and thinking must go together.
story.zh: 孔子：“学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆。”

usage.en: A quotation from the Analects; formal, used to make an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 《论语》引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 有朋自远方来，不亦乐乎
pinyin: yǒu péng zì yuǎn fāng lái, bù yì lè hū
literal: have · friend · from · distant · place · come, not · also · happy · [particle]
natural: Is it not a joy to have a friend come from afar?

meaning.en: The delight of welcoming a friend from far away; quoted when old friends visit.
meaning.zh: 有志同道合的朋友从远方来访，多么快乐，常用于欢迎远方朋友。

equivalents: what a joy when a friend visits from afar
a friend from afar is a delight

examples.zh: 老同学从国外回来，真是“有朋自远方来，不亦乐乎”。
examples.en: My old classmate is back from abroad: truly '§'.

examples.zh: 欢迎会上，主持人说：“有朋自远方来，不亦乐乎”。
examples.en: At the welcome party the host said, '§'.

story.en: The Analects open with Confucius naming the joys of learning, of friends arriving from afar, and of staying composed when unrecognised.
story.zh: 《论语·学而》开篇：“学而时习之，不亦说乎？有朋自远方来，不亦乐乎？”

usage.en: A rhetorical question used as a greeting or toast; formal, warm.
usage.zh: 反问句，用作欢迎或祝酒词，书面语，亲切。

text: 知之为知之，不知为不知，是知也
pinyin: zhī zhī wéi zhī zhī, bù zhī wéi bù zhī, shì zhì yě
literal: know · it · is · know · it, not · know · is · not · know, this · is · wisdom · [particle]
natural: To know what you know and admit what you do not: that is wisdom

meaning.en: Honestly distinguishing what you know from what you don't is true knowledge; a call for intellectual honesty.
meaning.zh: 知道就说知道，不知道就承认不知道，这才是真正的智慧，倡导诚实的学习态度。

equivalents: know what you know and what you don't
admit ignorance honestly

examples.zh: “知之为知之，不知为不知，是知也”，不懂就问不丢人。
examples.en: '§': there's no shame in asking when you don't understand.

examples.zh: 他一向实事求是，信奉“知之为知之，不知为不知，是知也”。
examples.en: He is always down to earth and lives by '§'.

story.en: Confucius advises his disciple Zilu on how to approach knowledge.
story.zh: 孔子教导子路：“由，诲女知之乎？知之为知之，不知为不知，是知也。”

usage.en: A quotation from the Analects; formal, used to make an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 《论语》引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 会当凌绝顶，一览众山小
pinyin: huì dāng líng jué dǐng, yī lǎn zhòng shān xiǎo
literal: certainly · will · ascend · utmost · summit, one · glance · many · mountains · small
natural: One day I will climb the summit and see all the mountains small below

meaning.en: A vow to reach the top and look down on lesser peaks; used for ambition and a broad outlook.
meaning.zh: 总有一天要登上山顶，俯瞰群山之小，比喻胸怀大志、眼界开阔。

equivalents: reach the summit and look down on all
aim for the top

examples.zh: 毕业时他在日记里写下“会当凌绝顶，一览众山小”。
examples.en: At graduation he wrote '§' in his diary.

examples.zh: 登上泰山顶，我想起了“会当凌绝顶，一览众山小”。
examples.en: Atop Mount Tai, I thought of '§'.

story.en: Du Fu wrote 'Gazing at the Peak' as a young man looking at Mount Tai, expressing his ambition.
story.zh: 杜甫青年时远望泰山所作，抒发登顶的壮志。

text: 欲渡黄河冰塞川，将登太行雪满山

natural: I would cross the Yellow River, but ice blocks it; I would climb the Taihang, but snow fills the mountains

meaning.en: Obstacles on every side; quoted for a path that is blocked just when you want to move forward.
meaning.zh: 想渡河而冰封，想登山而雪满，比喻前路受阻、困难重重。

equivalents: blocked on every road
obstacles at every turn

examples.zh: 创业之初，真是“欲渡黄河冰塞川，将登太行雪满山”。
examples.en: At the start of the business, it was truly '§'.

examples.zh: 他的处境，正如“欲渡黄河冰塞川，将登太行雪满山”。
examples.en: His situation is just as in '§'.

story.en: In the first of three 'Hard Road' poems, Li Bai laments the obstacles to his career before declaring his hope that the wind will one day carry him across the sea.
story.zh: 李白《行路难》其一，抒写仕途受阻的苦闷，后文又转为对前途的信心。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.

text: 国破山河在，城春草木深
pinyin: guó pò shān hé zài, chéng chūn cǎo mù shēn
literal: state · broken · mountains · rivers · remain, city · spring · grass · trees · deep
natural: The state is shattered, yet hills and rivers remain; spring comes to the city, grass and trees grow thick

meaning.en: The nation has fallen but nature carries on; quoted to lament ruin and the indifference of nature.
meaning.zh: 国家破亡而山河依旧，春天里城中草木荒深，感叹世事沧桑。

equivalents: the nation falls but the land endures
ruin amid spring

examples.zh: 看着废墟上长出的野草，他想起“国破山河在，城春草木深”。
examples.en: Seeing weeds grow on the ruins, he thought of '§'.

examples.zh: 战争纪录片里引用了“国破山河在，城春草木深”。
examples.en: The war documentary quoted '§'.

story.en: Du Fu wrote 'Spring View' in 757 while held in the capital Chang'an, which the An Lushan rebels had taken.
story.zh: 杜甫于757年困居被叛军占领的长安时所作。

text: 烽火连三月，家书抵万金
pinyin: fēng huǒ lián sān yuè, jiā shū dǐ wàn jīn
literal: beacon · fire · join · three · months, family · letter · worth · ten thousand · gold
natural: Beacon fires have burned three months; a letter from home is worth ten thousand in gold

meaning.en: In troubled times, news from family is priceless.
meaning.zh: 战火连月，家信难得，一封家书抵得上万两黄金。

equivalents: a letter from home is worth its weight in gold
news from home is priceless

examples.zh: 在外打拼的人，才懂“烽火连三月，家书抵万金”。

examples.en: During the lockdown, a message from family was truly '§'.

story.en: From Du Fu's 'Spring View': the war has dragged on and letters from his family are rare.
story.zh: 杜甫《春望》：战乱经年，音信隔绝，家书弥足珍贵。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 好雨知时节，当春乃发生
pinyin: hǎo yǔ zhī shí jié, dāng chūn nǎi fā shēng
literal: good · rain · know · season, at · spring · then · bring forth life
natural: Good rain knows its season: it falls in spring and brings life

meaning.en: Timely rain nourishes growth; also used for help that arrives at exactly the right moment.
meaning.zh: 好雨懂得时节，春天一到便降下，滋润万物，也比喻帮助来得恰逢其时。

equivalents: timely rain
help that comes at just the right time

examples.zh: 这场春雨“好雨知时节，当春乃发生”，农民都笑了。
examples.en: This spring rain '§' and the farmers all smiled.

examples.zh: 他的帮助来得正是时候，可谓“好雨知时节，当春乃发生”。
examples.en: His help came just in time: '§'.

story.en: Du Fu wrote the poem in Chengdu, delighted by gentle spring rain that falls at the right moment for the crops.
story.zh: 杜甫在成都草堂时所作，喜春雨应时而降。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

literal: follow · wind · sneak · into · night, moisten · things · fine · no · sound
natural: It slips in with the wind at night, moistening all things without a sound

meaning.en: Spring rain nourishes quietly; used for subtle, unobtrusive influence, as in good teaching or kindness.
meaning.zh: 春雨随风悄悄降临，无声滋润万物，比喻潜移默化的影响，如教育、关爱。

equivalents: nourishing quietly
a gentle influence that works unseen

examples.zh: 好老师的教育就像“随风潜入夜，润物细无声”。
examples.en: A good teacher's influence is like '§'.

examples.zh: 她的关怀“随风潜入夜，润物细无声”，让大家不知不觉改变了。
examples.en: Her care, '§', changed everyone without their noticing.

story.en: From Du Fu's 'Delight in Spring Rain', describing rain that falls gently and silently at night.
story.zh: 杜甫《春夜喜雨》：春雨夜里悄然而至，无声润泽万物。

literal: how · get · vast · mansions · thousand · ten thousand · rooms, greatly · shelter · world · poor · scholars · all · glad · faces
natural: If only I had thousands of vast mansions to shelter every poor scholar under heaven, all smiling

meaning.en: A wish to shelter all the poor; quoted for compassion and concern for the common people's welfare.
meaning.zh: 愿有千万间大屋庇护天下贫寒之士，表达关怀百姓疾苦的情怀。

equivalents: shelter for all the world's poor
a wish for everyone to have a home

examples.zh: 他一生致力于扶贫，真有“安得广厦千万间，大庇天下寒士俱欢颜”的情怀。
examples.en: He devoted his life to poverty relief, with the spirit of '§'.

examples.zh: 谈到住房保障，不少人引用了“安得广厦千万间，大庇天下寒士俱欢颜”。
examples.en: Talking about affordable housing, many cited '§'.

origin.source: 杜甫《茅屋为秋风所破歌》

story.en: Du Fu's thatched cottage was wrecked by autumn gales and rain; lying cold in the wet, he wished that all the poor could have shelter.
story.zh: 杜甫草堂屋顶被秋风掀翻，夜雨难眠，由己及人，发出此愿。

text: 朱门酒肉臭，路有冻死骨
pinyin: zhū mén jiǔ ròu chòu, lù yǒu dòng sǐ gǔ
literal: red · gate · wine · meat · rot, road · has · frozen · dead · bones
natural: Wine and meat rot behind the red doors, while frozen bones lie by the road

meaning.en: The rich waste food while the poor freeze to death; quoted to condemn extreme inequality.
meaning.zh: 富人家酒肉多得腐臭，路边却有冻死的穷人，批判贫富悬殊。

equivalents: the rich feast while the poor freeze
a gulf between rich and poor

examples.zh: 面对贫富差距，他感叹“朱门酒肉臭，路有冻死骨”。
examples.en: Faced with the wealth gap, he sighed '§'.

examples.zh: 这篇社论以“朱门酒肉臭，路有冻死骨”开头。
examples.en: The editorial opened with '§'.

origin.source: 杜甫《自京赴奉先县咏怀五百字》

story.en: Du Fu, passing the capital before the An Lushan rebellion, contrasts the court's luxury with the starving poor.
story.zh: 杜甫自长安赴奉先县途中，对比权贵奢靡与百姓冻馁。

text: 无边落木萧萧下，不尽长江滚滚来
pinyin: wú biān luò mù xiāo xiāo xià, bù jìn cháng jiāng gǔn gǔn lái
literal: boundless · falling · leaves · rustling · fall, endless · Yangtze · rolling · rolling · come
natural: Endless leaves fall rustling down; the unending Yangtze rolls on and on

meaning.en: A majestic autumn scene that evokes the passing of time and the vastness of nature.
meaning.zh: 无边的落叶萧萧而下，奔流的长江滚滚而来，景象壮阔，令人感叹时光流逝。

equivalents: falling leaves and the endless river
the sweep of autumn and time

examples.zh: 秋日登高，眼前正是“无边落木萧萧下，不尽长江滚滚来”。
examples.en: Climbing a height in autumn, before me was just '§'.

examples.zh: 这句“无边落木萧萧下，不尽长江滚滚来”写尽了秋天的苍凉。
examples.en: The line '§' captures the desolation of autumn.

story.en: From 'Ascending the Heights', written by an ageing, ill Du Fu in Kuizhou on the Double Ninth in 767.
story.zh: 杜甫767年重阳在夔州登高所作，时已年老多病。

text: 露从今夜白，月是故乡明
pinyin: lù cóng jīn yè bái, yuè shì gù xiāng míng
literal: dew · from · tonight · white, moon · is · old · home · bright
natural: The dew turns white from tonight; the moon is brightest over my home village

meaning.en: However bright the moon, it seems brightest at home; quoted for love of one's hometown.
meaning.zh: 今夜起露水转白，月亮还是故乡的最明亮，表达思念故乡。

equivalents: the moon is brighter back home
love for one's hometown

examples.zh: 身在异乡，才体会到“露从今夜白，月是故乡明”。
examples.en: Only when living away did I feel '§'.

examples.zh: 她的演讲结尾引用了“露从今夜白，月是故乡明”。
examples.en: She ended her speech by quoting '§'.

story.en: Du Fu, in a war-torn border town, thinks of his scattered brothers on the night of the White Dew solar term.
story.zh: 杜甫在战乱中于秦州，白露节气夜里思念离散的兄弟。

text: 两个黄鹂鸣翠柳，一行白鹭上青天
pinyin: liǎng gè huáng lí míng cuì liǔ, yī háng bái lù shàng qīng tiān
literal: two · orioles · sing · green · willows, one · row · egrets · rise · blue · sky
natural: Two orioles sing in the green willows; a line of egrets climbs the blue sky

meaning.en: A fresh, colourful spring scene; quoted for lively natural scenery.
meaning.zh: 两只黄鹂在翠柳上鸣叫，一行白鹭飞上青天，描绘生机盎然的春景。

equivalents: orioles in willows, egrets in the sky
a lively spring scene

examples.zh: 窗外正是“两个黄鹂鸣翠柳，一行白鹭上青天”的好风景。
examples.en: Outside the window was a fine view of '§'.

examples.zh: 小学课本里有“两个黄鹂鸣翠柳，一行白鹭上青天”。
examples.en: The primary-school textbook includes '§'.

story.en: Du Fu wrote this quatrain at his cottage in Chengdu, enjoying the spring view from his window.
story.zh: 杜甫在成都草堂所作，写窗前春景。

text: 读书破万卷，下笔如有神
pinyin: dú shū pò wàn juàn, xià bǐ rú yǒu shén
literal: read · books · break through · ten thousand · scrolls, put down · brush · as if · have · spirit
natural: Read ten thousand volumes, and the brush moves as if inspired

meaning.en: Wide reading is the foundation of fine writing.
meaning.zh: 博览群书，写文章时才能得心应手、如有神助。

equivalents: wide reading makes fluent writing
read widely to write well

examples.zh: 语文老师常说“读书破万卷，下笔如有神”。
examples.en: The Chinese teacher often says '§'.

examples.zh: 想写好作文，就要“读书破万卷，下笔如有神”。
examples.en: To write good essays you must '§'.

origin.source: 杜甫《奉赠韦左丞丈二十二韵》

story.en: Du Fu looks back on his own youth in a poem presented to the official Wei Ji, recalling how he studied.
story.zh: 杜甫赠韦济诗中自述青年时读书与写作的经验。

text: 出师未捷身先死，长使英雄泪满襟
pinyin: chū shī wèi jié shēn xiān sǐ, cháng shǐ yīng xióng lèi mǎn jīn
literal: send out · army · not yet · victorious · body · first · die, forever · make · heroes · tears · fill · lapels
natural: He died before his army could win; forever it makes heroes weep

meaning.en: A great man dies before completing his cause; said with grief at the death of someone whose work was unfinished.
meaning.zh: 大业未成而身先死，令后世英雄为之落泪，用于悼念壮志未酬者。

equivalents: died before achieving his goal
an unfinished cause

examples.zh: 这位科学家未能完成研究就去世了，真是“出师未捷身先死，长使英雄泪满襟”。
examples.en: The scientist died before finishing his research: truly '§'.

examples.zh: 读到诸葛亮的故事，不禁想起“出师未捷身先死，长使英雄泪满襟”。
examples.en: Reading of Zhuge Liang, one thinks of '§'.

story.en: Du Fu visited Zhuge Liang's shrine in Chengdu and mourned the chancellor, who died on campaign before restoring the Han.
story.zh: 杜甫游成都武侯祠，追悼诸葛亮北伐未成而病逝。

text: 飞流直下三千尺，疑是银河落九天
pinyin: fēi liú zhí xià sān qiān chǐ, yí shì yín hé luò jiǔ tiān
literal: flying · torrent · straight · down · three · thousand · feet, suspect · be · Silver · River · fall · ninth · heaven
natural: The torrent plunges straight down three thousand feet, as if the Milky Way were falling from the ninth heaven

meaning.en: A bold image of a towering waterfall; quoted to describe a magnificent cascade or an overwhelming rush.
meaning.zh: 瀑布从高处直泻而下，仿佛银河从天而降，形容瀑布的壮观。

equivalents: a waterfall like the Milky Way falling
a cascade from the heavens

examples.zh: 站在瀑布前，我脑海里只有“飞流直下三千尺，疑是银河落九天”。
examples.en: Standing before the falls, all I could think of was '§'.

examples.zh: 导游用“飞流直下三千尺，疑是银河落九天”来介绍庐山瀑布。
examples.en: The guide introduced the Lushan waterfall with '§'.

story.en: Li Bai gazing at the waterfall of Mount Lu (Lushan); the poem is a famous example of his bold hyperbole.
story.zh: 李白游庐山，望瀑布而作，夸张想象的名篇。

text: 君不见黄河之水天上来，奔流到海不复回
pinyin: jūn bù jiàn huáng hé zhī shuǐ tiān shàng lái, bēn liú dào hǎi bù fù huí
literal: you · not · see · Yellow · River · [of] · water · heaven · above · come, rush · flow · to · sea · not · again · return
natural: Do you not see the Yellow River's waters come down from heaven, rushing to the sea, never to return?

meaning.en: The river never flows back, just as time and youth do not return; quoted for the passing of time.
meaning.zh: 黄河之水从天上奔来，流入大海一去不回，比喻时光和青春一去不复返。

equivalents: time flows on like the river and never returns
what is gone does not come back

examples.zh: “君不见黄河之水天上来，奔流到海不复回”，时间一去不回头，要珍惜。
examples.en: '§': time never turns back, so treasure it.

examples.zh: 演讲开头他吟诵了“君不见黄河之水天上来，奔流到海不复回”。
examples.en: He opened the speech by chanting '§'.

story.en: The opening of Li Bai's drinking song 'Bring in the Wine', which laments the brevity of life and urges taking joy while one can.
story.zh: 李白《将进酒》开篇，感叹人生短暂，劝人及时行乐。

usage.en: A quoted opening line of verse; literary, often used to reflect on time passing.
usage.zh: 诗歌开篇引句，书面语，多用于感叹时光流逝。
